notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Paruns attached to Aphetto Alchemist.
Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw infinite cards, or use any of Staff of Domination's other abilities.
